epistemic_conflict.description: Researcher and Engineer agents developed divergent epistemic states on the root cause of the FPGA thermal surge.

researcher_state.root_cause_hypothesis: Bosonic Bottleneck Congestion in the photonic bus
researcher_state.proposed_action: reduce AdaQC concurrency from 7 to 3 slices

engineer_state.root_cause_hypothesis: ECR Gate Error Cascades on FPGA VCCINT rail

epistemic_conflict.arbiter_assessment: Both hypotheses are partially correct: the photonic bus saturation is a SYMPTOM of the ECR-driven retry storm, not an independent root cause. The Engineer's ECR cascade hypothesis is causally upstream, but the Engineer's STM lineage contains 3 beliefs that over-attribute the cascade to VCCINT alone (ignoring the NISQ cryo coupling). A Verifiable Semantic Rollback is required on the Engineer's STM to prune the over-attributed lineage without total context loss.

semantic_rollback.description: Prune the 'ECR Cascade on VCCINT alone' belief lineage from the Engineer's STM, preserving the correct causal-chain prefix (ECR cascade detected) but tombstoning the over-attributed conclusions (VCCINT is the sole cause). The tombstoned beliefs are retained for audit (ESR linearizability requires immutable history) but their salience is zeroed so they no longer influence policy decisions.

pruned_beliefs.prune_reason: ignores NISQ cryo coupling; photonic telemetry shows VCCINT is only 41% of the ECR contribution

pruned_beliefs.prune_reason: counterfactual simulation shows VCCINT reduction alone leaves F_total = 2.04 > G; requires combined ESV derating

pruned_beliefs.content: the photonic bus is not involved in this cascade
pruned_beliefs.prune_reason: photonic bus at 97% saturation IS involved — as the retry-storm propagation medium, not the root cause

preserved_beliefs.content: ECR gate error rate is 8x baseline (0.083 vs 0.010)
preserved_beliefs.preserve_reason: factually correct observation; root-cause attribution was the only issue

beliefs.proposition: ECR gate error cascades are causally upstream of photonic bus saturation during AdaQC/NISQ contention events.
Combined ESV derating (f_rpu = F_RPU_MIN + (1-F_RPU_MIN)×(1-ESV)²) + VCCINT weight reduction restores the safety envelope with margin ≥ 0.05 under high-entropy ECR stress.
The Researcher's Bosonic Bottleneck hypothesis is a valid SYMPTOM indicator (photonic saturation ≥ 0.95 correlates with contention) but not an independent root cause.

Whether ESV derating alone (without VCCINT reduction) suffices at lower ESV values
